description: The Canton of Vaud's building-energy cadastre links building identifiers to cadastral polygons and estimated energy attributes. RegEner records construction and renovation information, use, heated area, heating systems, thermal demand and consumption estimates. RegEnerGeo holds building geometry, while an associated table records extraction dates of the input sources. The resource combines federal and cantonal building registers, energy certificates, renovation grants, cadastral information and collected consumption data. Coverage is Vaud, with source data updated on 13 March 2026. Shapefile orders and Esri geodatabase, GeoPackage and Interlis 2 downloads are listed in CH1903+. The page quotes CHF 10 per square kilometre for orders, subject to limits, fees and exemptions, while also presenting download options; the applicable cost is unresolved. Provider conditions are linked as DCG 8401. The page labels updates on demand but also describes an annual state. Energy values are theoretical estimates and can differ from measurements. These fields support building-stock demand scenarios and heat-network planning. Related records describe Vaud heat-production plants and its 2035 supply scenario. Production availability remains unresolved because Viageo displays a demo label.
